0022600040.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 3rd in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (9-2, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the Warriors' 13th of the season. Golden State is on an eight-game winning streak with a 2-2 road record, while San Antonio is on a nine-game winning streak and is 5-0 on the road. Out for the Warriors are Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdomen soreness and a game-time decision. For the Spurs, Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 127-113 Warriors loss in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
